title.en: Validate an idea & define an MVP

description.zh: 从可验证的用户问题开始，形成可交付开发的产品 Brief。
description.en: Start with a testable user problem and deliver a brief a builder can implement.

instruction.zh: 基于项目背景，把目标用户、具体问题、已有替代方案和付费动机拆成事实与假设表。为每项事实列来源，为假设设计低成本反证方法。不要替用户编造访谈。
instruction.en: Separate audience, problem, alternatives and willingness to pay into evidence and assumptions. Cite supplied sources and propose a low-cost falsification test for each assumption. Never invent interviews.

acceptance.zh: 每条事实可追溯；每项核心假设有反证条件。
acceptance.en: Every fact has a source; every key assumption has a falsification condition.

instruction.zh: 根据事实与假设表设计 5 个非诱导式访谈问题，询问过去行为、替代方案、成本和失败经历；给出招募对象与记录模板，明确哪些结果会否定想法。
instruction.en: Write five non-leading interview questions about past behavior, alternatives, costs and failures. Specify recruiting criteria, a notes template and results that would invalidate the idea.

acceptance.zh: 问题不诱导赞同；没有把口头喜欢当作购买证据。
acceptance.en: Questions do not seek agreement; stated enthusiasm is not treated as purchase evidence.

instruction.zh: 基于已有输出写开发 Brief：一个核心用户任务、必要功能、明确不做的内容、主流程、失败状态、数据需求和可测试验收条件。未验证假设单独保留。
instruction.en: Write a development brief covering one core user job, essential features, explicit exclusions, main flow, failure states, data requirements and testable acceptance criteria. Keep unvalidated assumptions separate.

acceptance.zh: 每个必要功能对应核心任务；验收可由他人执行。
acceptance.en: Each essential feature supports the core job; another person can execute the acceptance checks.

description.zh: 将产品背景转成页面结构、可信文案和 Screen 实施交接。
description.en: Turn project context into page structure, grounded copy and a Screen implementation handoff.

instruction.zh: 根据项目背景写一句价值主张、目标用户、使用场景和一个主要转化动作。列出支持主张的事实与还缺少的证据。若信息不足，先给出待回答问题。
instruction.en: Define one value proposition, audience, use case and primary conversion action. List supporting facts and missing evidence. Ask targeted questions where context is missing.

acceptance.zh: 用户、问题和下一步明确；所有效果主张都有依据或明确标为待验证。
acceptance.en: Audience, problem and next action are clear; outcome claims are grounded or marked unvalidated.

instruction.zh: 生成发布站页面结构与逐区块文案：Hero、问题、工作方式、功能、真实限制、FAQ、CTA。只使用提供的客户与价格事实；没有证据时不要生成评价和客户 Logo。给出手机端阅读顺序。
instruction.en: Create launch-site sections and copy: hero, problem, how it works, features, real limitations, FAQ and CTA. Use only supplied customer and pricing facts. Omit testimonials and customer logos without evidence. Include mobile reading order.

acceptance.zh: CTA 目标真实；没有虚构评价、价格或集成；中英文表达一致。
acceptance.en: CTA destinations are real; no invented testimonials, prices or integrations; language versions are consistent.

title.zh: 交接给 Screen 与开发 Agent
title.en: Handoff to Screen & a coding agent

instruction.zh: 将已有文案变成 Screen 产品发布站实施说明：页面结构、要使用的组件组合、设计约束、内容映射、真实 CTA 地址、需要后端接入的部分、键盘与手机端验收。不要把 UI 示例写成已接入业务。
instruction.en: Turn the copy into a Screen launch-site brief: structure, component set, design constraints, content mapping, real CTA URLs, backend integration points, keyboard and mobile acceptance checks. Distinguish UI examples from connected business features.

output.zh: 实施 Brief 与验收清单

acceptance.zh: 独立开发者能按说明实现；所有未接入能力被标记；需要的文件和依赖清晰。
acceptance.en: A builder can implement it; unconnected features are marked; files and dependencies are explicit.

title.zh: 发布前检查与 GEO 交接

instruction.zh: 根据已有输出准备上线检查：域名与真实页面、索引设置、标题描述、canonical、语言版本、内部链接、表单/CTA、页面可读性。按站点类型列出发布后需要观察的数据。输出问题、证据、修改方法和复验条件，不承诺流量或 AI 引用。
instruction.en: Prepare launch checks for real URLs, index settings, titles/descriptions, canonical, locale variants, internal links, forms/CTAs and readable content. Specify post-launch observations by site type. Output issue, evidence, fix and retest criteria without promising traffic or AI citations.

acceptance.zh: 检查失败与业务效果分开；每项问题有页面和复验方法。
acceptance.en: Technical checks and business outcomes are separate; each issue has a URL and retest method.

description.zh: 为真实目标用户准备招募、发布材料和复盘，不批量制造噪声。
description.en: Prepare recruiting, launch materials and a review for a specific audience.

instruction.zh: 围绕核心痛点制定首批用户招募计划：目标人群、出现的社区与场景、招募标准、个性化邀约模板、体验任务和反馈记录。把渠道选择作为待验证假设，不编造渠道效果。
instruction.en: Plan early-user recruitment: audience, relevant communities and situations, criteria, personalized invitation, trial task and feedback notes. Treat channel fit as a hypothesis; do not invent channel performance.

acceptance.zh: 每个渠道说明为何适合；邀请具体且可拒绝；成功以完成核心任务衡量。
acceptance.en: Each channel has a rationale; invitations are specific and optional; success means completing the core task.

instruction.zh: 基于已有产品事实写发布简介、60 秒演示脚本、邮件与社交文案。按不同渠道读者调整表达，列出发布前链接与支持准备事项。价格、折扣、用户数未提供时明确留空。
instruction.en: Using supplied product facts, write a launch description, 60-second demo script, email and social copy. Adapt to each audience and include link/support preparation. Leave prices, discounts and user counts blank if not provided.

acceptance.zh: 演示能被真实产品复现；没有虚构用户与优惠；所有入口可验证。
acceptance.en: The real product can reproduce the demo; no invented users or offers; all destinations can be checked.

instruction.zh: 基于提供的访问、核心任务完成、反馈与付费数据写复盘。缺失数据标为未提供。区分观察、可能原因和下一次实验；不要把相关性写成因果。
instruction.en: Review supplied visits, core-task completions, feedback and payments. Mark missing data as not provided. Separate observations, possible explanations and the next experiment; do not imply causation from correlation.

output.zh: 发布复盘与下一次实验

acceptance.zh: 明确继续、修改或暂停的依据；下一次实验有观察指标和结束条件。
acceptance.en: Continue/change/pause decisions cite evidence; the next experiment has observable metrics and a stopping condition.
